checklist.item: Verify exact in-scope Move contracts, repos, and submission rules (severity, duplicates, disclosure) directly on the Hackenproof Aptos Function Values page.
Clone the official Aptos core repo and locate all Move packages/modules that define or handle function values, closures, or callable types.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the identified Move targets, enabling Move Prover/sui-prover plus frontier-LLM review for formal and semantic issues.
Manually inspect access-control patterns around function-value storage, capabilities, and who can invoke or drop them.
Audit business-logic flows for unexpected execution, privilege escalation, or state corruption when function values cross module boundaries.
Check for reentrancy, resource-leak, or oracle-trust issues that could arise from storing and later calling function values.
Confirm any candidate finding is reproducible on a fresh Aptos testnet deployment with clear transaction traces.
Draft submission containing PoC, root-cause explanation, impact, and severity rating that matches Hackenproof template requirements.
Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the Aptos Function Values bug bounty program directly on the HackenProof website to ensure accuracy and avoid any potential misunderstandings.
Identify the target Move smart contracts for the audit, which are likely hosted in a Git repository associated with the Aptos Function Values program.
Clone the target Git repository to obtain the latest version of the Move smart contracts.

Run agents/external_audit.py on the cloned repository, focusing on the Move smart contracts to perform source fetch, Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification where applicable, and frontier-LLM review.

Analyze the output from agents/external_audit.py to identify potential vulnerabilities, paying close attention to common issues such as access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic flaws.
Manually review the contracts against a real vulnerability taxonomy to ensure thorough coverage and identify any potential issues that may have been missed by the automated tools.
Document all findings, including potential vulnerabilities, and prepare a clear, concise report that includes steps to reproduce and recommended mitigations.
Ensure that the report meets the submission requirements outlined in the Aptos Function Values bug bounty program rules, including any specific formatting or content guidelines.
Submit the report to the HackenProof platform, following the program's guidelines for submission and ensuring that all required information is included to facilitate review and potential reward.
Verify current scope, rules, payout tiers, and eligible targets directly on https://hackenproof.com/programs/aptos-function-values before any other action
Locate and clone the exact git_repo(s) listed in the program scope for Aptos Function Values
Run agents/external_audit.py against the confirmed Move modules and entry functions from the cloned repo
Execute Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification via external_audit.py on all in-scope packages
Manually audit for access control, capability leaks, signer checks, and business logic flaws in the Move code
Manually review for oracle dependencies, state transition errors, and resource accounting issues
Cross-check Rust components (if any) tied to the Move contracts for integration bugs
Compile all verified findings with reproduction steps and impact into a Hackenproof-formatted submission
